items.title: Centcom chief calls carrier’s mission ‘one of the most operationally intense and consequential of the modern era’ amid mental health and supply issues
items.summary: Adm. Cooper visited the USS Lincoln in the Arabian Sea as reports have emerged of mental health and supply issues aboard the long-deployed aircraft carrier.
items.titleZh: 中央司令部负责人称，在心理健康和供应问题方面，该航空公司的任务是“现代最激烈、最重要的任务之一”
items.summaryZh: 库珀上将访问了阿拉伯海的林肯号航空母舰，有报道称这艘长期部署的航空母舰上出现了心理健康和供应问题。

items.title: People Are Turning to AI for Mental Health, California Wants It Banned
items.summary: A California bill is awaiting an Assembly vote to "place guardrails" around AI chatbots and prevent them from acting as therapists.
items.titleZh: 人们正在转向人工智能来促进心理健康，加利福尼亚州希望禁止它
items.summaryZh: 加利福尼亚州的一项法案正在等待议会投票，以在人工智能聊天机器人周围“设置护栏”，并阻止它们充当治疗师。

items.title: ‘Godfather of AI’ says billionaires like Elon Musk are right about the future of work—but he predicts mass unemployment is on its way
items.summary: While tech leaders paint a positive future where work is optional thanks to AI, the "Godfather of AI" Geoffrey Hinton warns they’re “betting on AI replacing a lot of workers.”
items.titleZh: “人工智能教父”表示，像埃隆·马斯克这样的亿万富翁对工作的未来是正确的，但他预测大规模失业正在发生
items.summaryZh: 虽然技术领导者描绘了一个积极的未来，由于人工智能，工作是可选的，但“人工智能教父”杰弗里·辛顿警告说，他们“押注人工智能取代了很多工人”

items.title: Why a veteran fund manager sees more trouble ahead for SpaceX as its post-IPO roller coaster continues
items.summary: George Noble, a former Fidelity fund manager, said the "Elon premium" that's helped drive bullish sentiment in Musk's companies is fading.
items.titleZh: 为什么一位资深基金经理认为，随着首次公开募股后的过山车继续，SpaceX将面临更多麻烦
items.summaryZh: 前富达基金经理乔治·诺布尔表示，帮助推动马斯克公司看涨情绪的“埃隆溢价”正在消退。
